headline: FRA Says 70 Per Cent Of Farmers Paid, Promises Rest Within 10 Days
summary: The Food Reserve Agency has paid 70% of farmers who supplied Grade A white maize and paddy rice in the 2025/2026 marketing season. The remaining payments are promised within 10 days.
why: The Food Reserve Agency is Zambia's state grain buyer, and its payments to farmers affect rural incomes and national maize supply and prices.
